name: productivity
description: Manage tasks, plan work, and build workplace memory with optional chat, project-tracker, knowledge-base, and office-suite integrations.

interface.longDescription: Use Productivity to manage local task lists, build workplace memory, and sync context from authenticated work tools where available. This plugin can write local task and memory files.
defaultPrompt: Use productivity to start a task list
Use productivity to update stale tasks
Use productivity to capture workplace memory
